text: Human business interaction typically requires the possibility that each party may fulfill only a portion of an intended collaboration, a partial performance option that mathematically rigid smart contracts do not accommodate.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Commerce – A Primer on Why Decentralized Reputation Verification Systems Are Needed (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3405401
